headlines.headline: AutoZone beat on earnings: Q4 EPS $56.05 vs ~$54.08 consensus; revenue $6.59B vs $6.7B expected; same-store sales +1.5% constant-currency vs 3.8% forecast. Shares +2.1% to ~$2,862 premarket.
headlines.why_it_matters: A profit beat driven by margin expansion (+182 bps gross, helped by tariff refunds and LIFO) is outweighing a sales miss — it frames the earnings-season tone where cost discipline matters more than top-line.

headlines.headline: Magnificent Seven mixed premarket: META +0.5%, GOOGL +0.8%, AMZN +0.6%, MSFT +0.4%; NVDA eased 0.2% and U.S.-listed TSMC/SK Hynix each lost 1%+ as yesterday's chip surge cools.
headlines.why_it_matters: Digestion after a record AI rally — the leadership baton is pausing, not yet passing.

headlines.headline: Shopify advanced premarket on a tie-up letting Meta's Muse AI agent complete purchases across Shopify stores via Shop Pay.
headlines.why_it_matters: Extends the Muse monetization story from engagement into commerce — it's the first concrete revenue-adjacent use case for Meta's consumer AI push.

headlines.headline: Alibaba's new in-house AI chip (Zhenwu V900) plus expanded data-center plans targeting 20GW by 2032 lifted its Hong Kong shares ~2-3%.
headlines.why_it_matters: Fresh validation of AI capex demand, but also a reminder that hyperscalers are building their own silicon — a competitive read-through for NVDA.

headlines.headline: Roche shares gained 2%+ after its obesity drug candidate cut blood glucose and body weight in data released this morning.
headlines.why_it_matters: Keeps the obesity-drug trade in motion and adds an international bid under the healthcare rotation.
